production_change: Evaluate a lazy per-call reverse index only for known multi-value collections with at least as many raw values as enum names. Preserve the existing scan for small inputs and unknown-count enumerables; preserve every alias, ordinal integer matching, parse semantics and insertion order.
compatibility: Original/final owning ViewFeatures suites and every individual focused generator case pass.
Actual MVC DataAnnotations metadata contains the complete eight/64-member enums and aliases.
Real FormValueProvider, CollectionModelBinder and EnumTypeModelBinder produce names, numbers, lowercase, invalid, mixed and undefined numeric ModelState.
Typed model lists and actual iterator producers exercise model fallback.
All 41 setups assert complete current-value sets and encoded select HTML, including aliases, flags, invalid CSS and selected/unselected options.
No process-wide metadata cache, exported API, dependency change or cross-assembly private access.

measurement.policy: Measure actual target; retain every timing/allocation trade-off and all controls; publish no optimization PR without a supported gain.

hot_reload: Index lifetime is one call, not static/singleton or retained across renders. No new metadata-update handler or live-edit validation is required.
excluded: Composition with F021 or other proposals
tuning_after_round_1: Large valid/typed cases improved 56-84 percent, but sparse invalid submissions increased heap 42-45 percent and empty/small controls regressed. Keep round 1 intact. Evaluate collection eligibility lazily only after a parsed enum value, and leave known-invalid ModelState on the original scan without allocating an index or reading its error collection. All original compatibility and measurement criteria remain unchanged; two comparisons remain.
new_unverified_boundary: Sparse invalid model/ViewData fallback without an invalid ModelState entry can still pay reverse-index setup costs; no all-input performance or cold-error-collection claim.
